description:
What is This Part?
This is a Complete Set of Suzuki OEM Shackles for the Front or Rear Leaf Springs
This kit also includes the Bushings, Spacers (bolt sleeve) and bolts/nuts for the leaf springs and the shackles
2 Shackle Set Does Front or Rear Leaf Springs
Suzuki OEM
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – AG Grade Bolts, Washers, and Nuts for Leaf Springs
Qty 2 – Spacers (Bolt Sleeve)
Qty 4 – Large Bushings
Qty 8 – Small Bushings
Qty 2 – Outer Shackle Plates
Qty 2 – Inner Shackle Plates
Qty 4 – AG Grade Bolts (Pins), Washers, and Nuts for Shackle
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
